headline: Everybody is getting ahead. Why won't the money reach me?
note: Wired 2026-08-25 from fb-tarot/docs/writeups/shadow/REVIEW-money-alone-commit-2026-08-25.md — approved copy, transferred verbatim. Reuses the existing MONEY_TAROT_HOOKS frame; no new guard.

a: You turned the Magician. The picture was hidden, but your hand went to the one standing openly with every tool.
He stands in the open behind a table where all four tools are visible.
You asked why money reaches everyone else and not you. The open, complete table is the part I keep coming back to.
And yet the money has not reached you, while everyone else appears ahead.
There's something between your complete table and the result. I don't think it began with you.
Let me look closer at what's holding your result…
b: You turned the Hanged Man. You chose without seeing him and found the card held by one thing.
One rope holds one ankle. The rest of the figure has room.
You asked why the money has not reached you. This card makes me look at the one point doing the holding.
Still, your result remains held beside the comparison in your question.
What has hold of your result keeps it from reaching you. I don't think this began with you.
Let me see what that obstruction is…
c: You turned the Fool. The cards were face down, yet you reached for the one in full light.
The full sun is high in the gold sky behind him.
You asked why others get ahead while the money does not reach you. The full light on this card catches me.
But the money has not reached you, while everyone else appears ahead.
Something appears right where the money would reach you. I don't think it started with you.
Now let's look at what's behind it…
